title: Union County Museum

services.name: Rental Venue
services.desc: Built in 1874, the Museum's Little White Church is located in the heart of Union at 366 South Main Street, at the corner of Dearborn Street. Parking is available on both sides of Main Street and Dearborn. The building offers 840 square feet of floor space, plus a raised stage area that is 6 feet deep and 13 feet wide. An anti-room behind the stage is suitable as a dressing room, with a restroom located off the anti-room. To learn more about reserving the Little White Church for your event, please contact Carol by
